tooltip.darkspawn.ground_walker: Place on clear solid ground. One pilot; ground travel and one-block steps. Iron repairs; capsules store.
message.darkspawn.ground_walker_mounted: Ground Walker: WASD to move, Jump, Sneak to dismount. No flight or weapons.
message.darkspawn.ground_walker_blocked: Placement blocked: the walker needs clear space and safe solid ground.
message.darkspawn.ground_walker_placed: Ground Walker placed and bound to you. Empty-hand use pilots; iron repairs. Sneak-use for recovery instructions.
message.darkspawn.ground_walker_care: Repair with iron. Land and use a companion capsule to store. Defeat recovery uses a veterinary kit and recovery token. No cargo or animal care.
message.darkspawn.ground_walker_repair_w: Repairs require damage and two seconds between uses.
